author: Ceus
quote: GTA-6 doesn’t feel like a GTA game at all. The graphics are amazing, the map is huge, and the detail is insane. But those are the only good things in the game. The story is very weak in GTA. The main character is bland and boring, and I don't connect with his girlfriend at all. There's barely any gunplay. Heists are very very rare and short, and most missions are just chores & errands - collect rent, grill burgers, play mini golf, help his girlfriend assemble ikea table. Hookers are not part of the game. Mission replay is gone. You only get 15 save slots. No safe houses, no pets, no stock market, and you pay $100 every time you fast travel. The new wanted system ****!!! The free aim is clunky, driving isn't fun anymore and you can't even steal every car you see. The NPCs overreact to everything, the Ul is a mess, and it's locked at 30 FPS, even on PS5 Pro. Rockstar says the PS5 Pro is "not powerful enough* for 60. There’s no humor in any of the characters.
